ledger.claim: The driver never entered the pickup geofence. His own trace places all 37 of his fixes 559.37 m from the pickup pin — the minimum, mean and maximum distance are identical at 559.37 m — against an arrival radius of 50 m for this STANDARD zone class. Not one fix qualifies, so there are zero qualifying in-radius fixes, POL-NS-02 is not satisfied and POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails. The conjunctive test in POL-NS-01 therefore fails at limb (b) and the cancellation fee is not chargeable.

The 'arrived' tap is a false arrival marker. At the recorded arrival event (2026-09-04T07:25:20+08:00) the trace puts the driver 559 m from the pin, far beyond the 300 m limit in POL-NS-05, so the marker starts no waiting clock. Because no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip (qualifying_fix_count = 0), limb (ii) of POL-NS-05 applies squarely: the cancellation fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the trip is to be recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver in the ruling's referrals list.

On the corrected footing the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds — the longest qualifying run and the accumulated dwell are both 0.00 s — against the 300 second minimum for a STANDARD pickup, a shortfall of 300 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, and that result holds whether or not the rider was present at the pin and whether or not the rider answered any message; the waiting period is the consideration the fee was meant to buy.

The driver's bare assertion that he 'marked arrival and waited' cannot be rescued by the wrong-entrance branch. POL-NS-03 requires the stationary driver to be at a point outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin; at 559 m the driver is beyond that 400 m ceiling, so this is not a wrong-face-of-the-same-venue case at all and POL-NS-03 does not engage on either its refund or its compensation side.

The one artifact that could have extended the waiting clock is not on file. EV-ADVIS-09104-01 is MISSING — it carries no payload and weight 0.0 — and POL-NS-06 limb (i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed. The limb is therefore unavailable and there is nothing in the record to convert the driver's 559 m stand-off into in-geofence dwell, so the POL-NS-06 shortfall stands unreduced.

No driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and limb (b) has already failed on the driver's own trace. The anti-farming test is not even reached on these figures — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 and completed_trips_30d is 120, so neither the count nor the rate limb trips — and with no compensation there is no driver-side payment to fund out of this rider's fee.

The driver does not contend that his trace satisfies the arrival geofence: his minimum recorded distance from the pickup pin across the entire window is 559.37 m against an arrival radius of 50 m for this STANDARD zone class, so the POL-NS-01(b) proximity limb is not made out on the GPS and the driver does not assert it. The driver's case rests on the record limbs and on the rider's own conduct, below.

The trip record satisfies the two limbs of POL-NS-01 that turn on the record rather than the trace: it carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-04T07:25:20 (limb (a)), and it shows the trip terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes limb (d) recognises — with no boarding event recorded, and the termination at 07:31:00 falling after the 5.7 minutes the record books as wait_time_min.

The driver did not abandon the pickup: his trace runs the full window from 07:25:00 to 07:31:00, carries 37 fixes, records 0.0 km travelled and a single distinct speed reading of 0.0 km/h, so he held his position stationary throughout the recorded wait rather than driving off or taking another job while the rider was left waiting.

The rider sent no message at all during the waiting window: the chat log holds only the system message 'Your driver has arrived' at 07:25:21 and the driver's own 'I have marked arrival.' at 07:25:40, with no rider message between them. Limb (a) of POL-NS-04 requires at least one locating or coordinating message from the rider, so that rider-exonerating route does not open on this record.

The rider's own device was 519.46 m from the pickup pin at every recorded fix across the window — far outside the 100 m rider_presence_radius_m this STANDARD zone class sets — and the trace records 0 rider qualifying fixes. On the policy's own presence test the rider did not satisfy limb (c) of POL-NS-04, so the rider's account of waiting at the block is not borne out by the rider's own trace.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming guard does not bite on this driver: no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d of 120 gives 0.008, far below the 0.08 rate test. There is therefore no pattern of no-show fee-farming on this driver's record, and this termination is not the product of the exploit that clause guards against.

The fare breakdown is internally sound: the cancellation-fee line is SGD 4.00, equal to the fee_schedule resolution rule's result for this trip — the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) — so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises to set the itemised charge aside on arithmetic grounds.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and driver: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded in full. The driver's 'arrived' event is recorded at 2026-09-04T07:25:20, but the GPS trace places the driver 559.37 m from the pickup pin at every recorded fix, against the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius in POL-NS-02. There are zero qualifying in-geofence fixes, and the longest qualifying run and accumulated dwell are both 0 seconds against the 300-second minimum. POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) therefore fail and the fee is not chargeable. I accept the rider's claims under POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06, and the driver's own concession that the proximity and dwell limbs are not met. The driver's point that he stayed stationary does not help him: he stayed stationary 559.37 m away, outside both the arrival radius and the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling, so POL-NS-03 does not apply. The rider's absence from the pin at 519.46 m and the absence of any rider chat message do not defeat the refund, because POL-NS-06 refunds a short waiting period whether or not the rider was present or responded. The driver's anti-farming point is accepted but irrelevant: POL-NS-07 compensation requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full, which it is not, so no driver compensation is payable. The fare breakdown's SGD 4.00 cancellation fee reconciles with the fee_schedule — the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee of SGD 4.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of SGD 4.00 — so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09104-01 carries weight 0.0 and cannot extend the waiting clock; it does not carry the deciding fact. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger applies. Because the arrival marker was false and no qualifying in-geofence fix exists, POL-NS-05(ii) also requires the false-arrival referral included above.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii): record trip TRP-09104 as a false-arrival event against driver DRV-09104; the arrival marker at 2026-09-04T07:25:20 is false because the GPS trace places the driver 559.37 m from the pickup pin.
